name: Quantum Dawn Series (SIFMA)
description: Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association (SIFMA) series of large-scale cyber wargames testing the resilience of U.S. financial markets to coordinated, sophisticated cyber attacks. Exercises involve major banks, broker-dealers, exchanges, clearing firms, and regulators practicing cross-sector coordination, information sharing, and crisis-mode decision-making under simulated systemic market disruption.
reputation: Primary U.S. financial sector cyber resilience exercise; foundational for FSSCC and FS-ISAC coordination protocols
notes: Exercises held periodically; major iterations include Quantum Dawn 1 (2011), 2 (2013), 3 (2015), 4 (2019). Involves hundreds of firms and regulators including the SEC, CFTC, and Federal Reserve.

institutions: SIFMA (Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association)
FS-ISAC (Financial Services Information Sharing and Analysis Center)
